description: This file declares the ResourceManager class, which implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for resource management within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for initialization, deinitialization, and resource control functions, as well as internal state and configuration variables.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: A class implementing plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for resource management, including methods for resource control and internal state management.
